methodology: Family granularity minimizes family encoded size/horizon + train average physical passage payload, using actual shared chunk bytes; evaluated on separate queries with real source exact reconstructions.
limitations: No SSD I/O, actual RAG generator, or dense neural search
One repository, query distribution may differ markedly in real deployments
Serialized metadata costs included; Python runtime/RAM excluded
Mixed granularity may lose cross-family dedup; actual globally deduplicated source size counted
Amortization horizon is a hypothetical source-byte/read-byte equivalence, not an economic cost model
Queries use BM25-selected top-ten versions and five-line passages, not independently labeled answer support
